responsibility_review.finding: Protocol holds typed wire outcomes/capability limits; client performs public transport and media negotiation; service maps authenticated transport authority; Store enforces transaction-local current credential/membership/task state and authoritative journal; server composes optional adapters/listeners and lifecycle workers. Review found no new cross-crate authority bypass in inspected independently authored paths.

Versioned first-run state uses protected new staging and explicit publication; existing partial/private state is inspected rather than adopted. Current vault authority and intent-bound references are separate from values; legacy migration confirms original read-back and uncertain resource state before publication. No new source-side replacement-secret or ambient-fallback route identified.

Pairing uses exact owner/completing credential, bounded attempts and hash-only challenge storage; current checks precede mutation replay. Native verification remains identity-only and cannot supply Conversation membership or SMS consent.

Owner and Native task terminal-state lookups recheck current credential/grant/task/parent/membership and exact participant in one Store transaction. allow-ended is a separate trusted cleanup path; live binding still requires accepted/ready. Resolver additionally verifies issuer/tenant/principal expiry and canonical projection namespace. Unknown/revoked/storage errors do not become terminal authorization.

Native example depends on public connect-client/protocol and owns external FFmpeg capture/codec/renderer tasks; standalone connector dependency manifests use public API rather than Store/server/service. Review-loop uses an application-local SQLite ledger, distinct from Connect Store. Private Core/server composition is used only by test fixtures. This dependency review is not independent approval of this reviewer’s authored adapter implementation.

terminal_backpressure_review.finding: Exact resources are removed first. Wire SessionEnd and SessionEnded adapter event are polled concurrently under one absolute2-second delivery deadline; a saturated wire channel cannot serialize adapter teardown behind general signaling. On any critical delivery failure, cancellation is visible immediately and owned coordinator abort is bounded by the original absolute3-second terminal deadline. Error closes the whole physical peer, including sibling physical streams, but does not mutate sibling durable Session/Conversation history.
terminal_backpressure_review.activation_boundary: Opt-in supports_terminal_session_retirement; existing default resolver follows prior guard. Trusted current peer+exact canonical Session classification precedes retirement. Principal/unknown/store failure remains whole-peer fail-closed.
